text:
sam: FYI security-led rebuild needed. libssl CVE-2026-1234 found in our ubuntu-minimal base. Plan: rebuild + key rotation + tightened RBAC + export KMS audit logs. Proposing maintenance window Sat 2026-04-03 01:30-03:30 UTC. Thoughts?

anika: I can own the IAM changes. We should scope signer SA binding down to the CI project, and add a conditional binding for tag `env=ci`. Will open an IAM PR for review.

marco: I'll modify CI to handle key rotation seamlessly. Idea: pipeline supports two signer URIs (old + new) for verification during cutover and has a `--kms-dryrun` mode. Example cosign sign step: `cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/signerKey`

liu: I'll take on audit export and alerts. Need KMS Admin to confirm export destination and retention. We should compute alert thresholds for unexpected signer usage.

jess: I'll run monitoring for canary. What telemetry do we want to watch? Latency, image pull errors, signature verification failures, and SBOM mismatches.

deploy-bot: image-scan: 1 medium vuln detected (libssl CVE-2026-1234) in ubuntu-minimal:1.14. Logged to SEC-2026-112.

sam: timeline suggestion: build+sign in staging at 01:30, staging canary 01:45-02:00 (small fleet), prod canary 02:00-03:00 (5%), full rollout 03:00-03:30. Rollback window will be open during canary.

marco: pipeline notes: I'll add a verification matrix that tries `cosign verify --key` against both URIs. Also add automatic SBOM publish (syft -> artifacts) and attach cosign provenance.

anika: IAM checklist I'm adding to PR: 1) grant roles/cloudkms.signer only to `svc-ci-signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` in infra project; 2) add a conditional binding limited to serviceAccount in the CI project; 3) remove any broad org-level bindings; 4) add temporary binding for rotation window if needed.

liu: audit export plan: sink Cloud KMS audit logs to `gs://redwood-sec-audit/keys/` with 90d retention on analyzed index, and long-term cold storage export for >1y. I'll validate log export during preflight.

jess: monitoring setup: create Grafana panel for signature verify failures, image-pull 4xx/5xx, and canary error budget. I'll snapshot dashboards at start of canary.

sam: rollback playbook (minimal):
```
- Abort rollout via router: gradual percentages -> 0
- Disable new KMS key version: `gcloud kms keys versions disable --name=...`
- Redeploy prior image tag: `kubectl set image ... image=ubuntu-minimal:v1.13-signed`
- Re-open incident channel and notify compliance
```

marco: small gotcha: cosign references KMS key version; during rotation the URI will point to new version. I'll keep previous version URI in config so verifying existing manifests remains possible.

anika: add to PR: IAM change must include a binding for `roles/logging.viewer` for compliance sidecar to access KMS logs? or do we prefer a separate log-sink SA?

liu: prefer log-sink SA with least privilege. I'll provision `svc-account:log-sink@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and grant it only the permission to write to the audit bucket. No broad viewer perms.

compliance-bot: reminder: any key rotation affecting production requires a 48h notice to Compliance. Tag SEC-2026-112 with `compliance:pending` and attach runbook.

sam: noted. I'll file the notice. Also need to ensure SBOM includes package layers and build tool versions. Marco, can pipeline produce a normalized SBOM (cycloneDX) and upload?

marco: yes, syft -> cyclonedx output is trivial. I'll add an artifact metadata file: `sbom.json` + `cosign.provenance.json`.

anika: small security ask: limit the signer SA's token lifetime, and require workload identity for CI runners instead of long-lived keys. I'll include this in PR.

liu: preflight checklist I'll run tomorrow: 1) verify KMS sink write access; 2) simulate cosign verify against both URIs; 3) ensure alerts fire on simulated anomalous signer usage.

jess: I'll be on call for canary and keep a rolling 15m update in thread. If I see signature mismatches or image pull errors >1% I'll pause rollout.

sam: final task owners: anika (IAM PR + least-privilege bindings), marco (CI + SBOM + cosign dual-URI support), liu (audit export + alerts + log-sink SA), jess (canary monitoring), sam (coord, compliance notice, SEC ticket updates).

marco: pushing a draft pipeline MR to `gitlab.com/redwood/infra/ci` with `--kms-dryrun` and dual-verify. Will link MR in SEC-2026-112.

anika: PR will include terraform diff and a short justification for conditional bindings.

liu: I'll add a short playbook snippet to the ticket showing `gcloud` commands for disabling key versions and for restoring previous manifests.

compliance-bot: checklist update: ensure SBOM + cosign provenance preserved in artifact store and retention policy matches compliance retention requirements.

sam: thanks everyone. I'll post the final runbook + scheduled maintenance message once IAM PR and pipeline MR are in draft. Ping if blocked. :thumbsup:
